summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from an app called Hurdlr, which focuses on financial tracking and savings. The screen explains how Hurdlr helps users save money through three main points:

1. Hurdlr tracks all business finances, helping to lower taxes and save money.
2. It monitors earnings for real-time tax calculations and tracks expenses to reduce taxable income.
3. Lower taxable income results in more savings.

At the bottom of the screen, there is a progress indicator with the text "SIGNING YOU UP..." indicating that the user is in the process of being registered or logged into the app. The background is green with a graphical representation of bar charts, emphasizing financial growth and savings.
